The subject is holding a white rolled document (likely a diploma) in their left hand. The background shows an indoor setting with a window and some greenery.

The image is taken from the back/rear-three-quarter view. The center-front opening is occluded by the subject's body and the angle of the shot, making it impossible to verify directly.
